&#9744;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-12-17to2025-12-17" name="dei:AmendmentDescription" id="ixv-112"><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Explanatory Note: </strong>AI Technology Group Inc. is filing this Amendment No. 1 to its Current Report on Form 8-K (this &#8220;Amendment&#8221;), originally filed with the Securities Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;) on December 17, 2025 (the &#8220;Original 8-K&#8221;), to replace an incorrect version of the Share Exchange Agreement filed as Exhibit 2.1. The correct version of the Share Exchange Agreement, which is the version amended, executed and delivered among the parties thereto, is filed as Exhibit 10.1 hereto and supersedes and replaces in its entirety Exhibit 2.1 to the Original 8-K. This Amendment amends or changes the defined term &#8220;AVM&#8221; to &#8220;AVMN&#8221; from the information previously disclosed in the Original Form 8-K. Further, the Company has amended Item 2.01 to amend its Convertible Debentures amounted to $1,587,00, an increase of $462,000, convertible into 634,800 common shares of the Corporation, an increase of 50,000 shares of common stock.</p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160; </p><table style="font-size:1px;width:100%"><tbody><tr><td style="BORDER-BOTTOM: 2px solid;"/></tr><tr><td style="BORDER-BOTTOM: 5px solid;"/></tr></tbody></table><table style="border-spacing:0;font:10pt times new roman;width:100%" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr style="height:15px"><td class="hpbhr">&#160;</td></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td style="TEXT-INDENT: 0px;"/></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td><p style="page-break-after: always"></p></td></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td>&#160;</td></tr></tbody></table><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160; &#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Item 1.01 &#8211; Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">On December 15, 2025, AI Technology Group Inc. (the &#8220;Corporation&#8221;) entered into a <strong>Share Exchange Agreement</strong> as amended hereto with <strong>AVM Biotechnology Inc.</strong>, a Nevada corporation (&#8220;AVMN&#8221;), and <strong>Biomed 360 Solutions Corp.</strong>, a British Columbia corporation (&#8220;Biomed 360&#8221;), the sole shareholder of AVMN.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">Under the terms of the agreement, the Corporation agreed to acquire <strong>100% of the issued and outstanding shares of AVMN</strong> in exchange for <strong>100 common shares of the Corporation</strong>. As a result, AVMN became a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Corporation.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">The transaction is intended to qualify as a <strong>tax-free reorganization</strong> under Section 368 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Item 2.01 &#8211; Completion of Acquisition or Disposition of Assets</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">On December 15, 2025, the Corporation completed the acquisition of AVMN.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><table style="border-spacing:0;text-align:left;font:10pt times new roman;width:100%" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr style="height:15px"><td style="width:4%;"><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;</p></td><td style="width:4%;vertical-align:top;"><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Consideration:</strong> 100 common shares of the Corporation issued to Biomed 360 in exchange for 100 common shares of AVM.</p></td></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p></td><td style="vertical-align:top;"><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><span style="font-family:symbol">&#183;</span></p></td><td style="vertical-align:top;"><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p></td><td style="vertical-align:top;"><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><span style="font-family:symbol">&#183;</span></p></td><td style="vertical-align:top;"><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Convertible Debentures:</strong> On December 15, 2025, AVMN had outstanding convertible debentures totaling $1,587,000, convertible into 634,800 common shares of the Corporation. These debentures will be converted into common shares of the Corporation pursuant to the Share Exchange Agreement.</p></td></tr></tbody></table><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Item 3.02 &#8211; Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">The shares issued in connection with the acquisition were not registered under the Securities Act of 1933 and are considered <strong>restricted securities</strong> under Rule 144. The issuance was made in reliance upon exemptions from registration provided by Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt;
